snippet.title: Spilled! - Official Console Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description:
Clean up ocean waste in this short & relaxing game! Recycle, earn coins and upgrade your boat. Explore new areas. Clean bigger spills and different kinds of waste!
Spilled! is coming soon to Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch!
